     * @dev Returns the absolute unsigned value of a signed value.
     */
    function abs(int256 n) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        unchecked {
            // must be unchecked in order to support `n = type(int256).min`
            return uint256(n >= 0 ? n : -n);
        }
    }
}

/// @title IHub

/// @notice ERC4626 functions of a Venus Liquidity Hub used by the CollateralGateway and SmartDCA.
interface IHub {
    /// @notice Get the underlying asset the hub accepts.
    /// @return address The underlying asset.

    /// @param receiver The address credited with the shares.
    /// @return uint256 The amount of shares minted.

    /// @notice Burn `shares` of `owner` and send the underlying to `receiver`.

    /// @param owner The address whose shares are burned.

    /// @param assets The amount of underlying to withdraw.

    /// @notice Get the underlying paid for redeeming `shares`, rounded down.
    /// @param shares The amount of shares to redeem.
    /// @return uint256 The amount of underlying.
    function previewRedeem(uint256 shares) external view returns (uint256);
}

/// @title IComptroller
/// @author Venus Protocol
/// @notice Interface for the Venus Comptroller with market management and risk parameter functions.
interface IComptroller {
    enum Action {
        MINT,
        REDEEM,
        BORROW,
        REPAY,
        SEIZE,
        LIQUIDATE,
        TRANSFER,
        ENTER_MARKET,
        EXIT_MARKET
    }

    /// @notice Pause or unpause specific actions on given markets.
    /// @param markets_ The list of vToken market addresses.
    /// @param actions_ The list of actions to pause/unpause.
    /// @param paused_ True to pause, false to unpause.
    function setActionsPaused(address[] calldata markets_, Action[] calldata actions_, bool paused_) external;

    /// @notice Set borrow caps for the given markets.
    /// @param vTokens The list of vToken market addresses.
    /// @param newBorrowCaps The list of new borrow cap values.
    function setMarketBorrowCaps(address[] calldata vTokens, uint256[] calldata newBorrowCaps) external;

    /// @notice Set supply caps for the given markets.
    /// @param vTokens The list of vToken market addresses.
    /// @param newSupplyCaps The list of new supply cap values.
    function setMarketSupplyCaps(address[] calldata vTokens, uint256[] calldata newSupplyCaps) external;

    /// @notice Unlist a market from the comptroller.
    /// @param vToken The vToken market address to unlist.
    /// @return uint256 Error code (0 = success).
    function unlistMarket(address vToken) external returns (uint256);

    /// @notice Execute a flash loan.
    /// @param onBehalf The address on whose behalf the flash loan is executed.
    /// @param receiver The address receiving the flash loan funds.
    /// @param vTokens The list of vToken markets to borrow from.
    /// @param underlyingAmounts The list of underlying amounts to borrow.
    /// @param param Additional parameters for the flash loan callback.
    function executeFlashLoan(
        address payable onBehalf,
        address payable receiver,
        IVToken[] memory vTokens,
        uint256[] memory underlyingAmounts,
        bytes memory param
    ) external;

    /// @notice Enter multiple markets to use as collateral.
    /// @param vTokens The list of vToken market addresses to enter.
    /// @return uint256[] Error codes for each market (0 = success).
    function enterMarkets(address[] calldata vTokens) external returns (uint256[] memory);

    /// @notice Enter a market on behalf of another address.
    /// @param onBehalf The address to enter the market for.
    /// @param vToken The vToken market address.
    /// @return uint256 Error code (0 = success).
    function enterMarketBehalf(address onBehalf, address vToken) external returns (uint256);

    /// @notice Enter a market for a specific user (internal comptroller use).
    /// @param user The user address.
    /// @param vToken The vToken market address.
    /// @return uint256 Error code (0 = success).
    function enterMarket(address user, address vToken) external returns (uint256);

    /// @notice Enter a market for an account. The caller needs the ACM permission for `enterMarketForAccount(address,address)`.
    /// @param account The account to enter the market for.
    /// @param vToken The vToken market address.
    /// @return uint256 Error code (0 = success).
    function enterMarketForAccount(address account, address vToken) external returns (uint256);

    /// @notice Check whether an action is paused on a given market.
    /// @param market The vToken market address.
    /// @param action The action to check.
    /// @return bool True if the action is paused.
    function actionPaused(address market, Action action) external view returns (bool);

    /// @notice Get market information for a given vToken.
    /// @param vToken The vToken market address.
    /// @return isListed Whether the market is listed.
    /// @return collateralFactorMantissa The collateral factor mantissa.
    /// @return isComped Whether the market receives COMP/XVS rewards.
    function markets(
        address vToken
    ) external view returns (bool isListed, uint256 collateralFactorMantissa, bool isComped);

    /// @notice Get the price oracle used by the comptroller.
    /// @return ResilientOracleInterface The oracle contract.
    function oracle() external view returns (ResilientOracleInterface);

    /// @notice Check if an account has entered a given market.
    /// @param account The account address.
    /// @param vToken The vToken market to check membership for.
    /// @return bool True if the account is a member of the market.
    function checkMembership(address account, IVToken vToken) external view returns (bool);

    /// @notice Get the borrowing power of an account.
    /// @param account The account address.
    /// @return error Error code (0 = success).
    /// @return liquidity The account's excess liquidity.
    /// @return shortfall The account's shortfall.
    function getBorrowingPower(
        address account
    ) external view returns (uint256 error, uint256 liquidity, uint256 shortfall);

    /// @notice Get an account's liquidity as it would be after redeeming or borrowing in one market.
    /// @param account The account address.
    /// @param vTokenModify The vToken market the redeem or borrow applies to.
    /// @param redeemTokens The amount of vTokens to redeem.
    /// @param borrowAmount The amount of underlying to borrow.
    /// @return error Error code (0 = success).
    /// @return liquidity The account's excess liquidity.
    /// @return shortfall The account's shortfall.
    function getHypotheticalAccountLiquidity(
        address account,
        address vTokenModify,
        uint256 redeemTokens,
        uint256 borrowAmount
    ) external view returns (uint256 error, uint256 liquidity, uint256 shortfall);

    /// @notice Get the treasury fee percentage.
    /// @return uint256 The treasury percentage mantissa.
    function treasuryPercent() external view returns (uint256);

    /// @notice Get the borrow cap for a given market.
    /// @param vToken The vToken market address.
    /// @return uint256 The borrow cap.
    function borrowCaps(address vToken) external view returns (uint256);

    /// @notice Get the supply cap for a given market.
    /// @param vToken The vToken market address.
    /// @return uint256 The supply cap.
    function supplyCaps(address vToken) external view returns (uint256);

    /// @notice Check if a delegate is approved to borrow on behalf of a borrower.
    /// @param borrower The borrower address.
    /// @param delegate The delegate address.
    /// @return bool True if the delegate is approved.
    function approvedDelegates(address borrower, address delegate) external view returns (bool);

    function getAccountLiquidity(address account) external view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256);

    function exitMarket(address vToken) external returns (uint256);

    function updateDelegate(address delegate, bool approved) external;

    /// @notice Claim the XVS rewards `holder` accrued in the given markets.
    /// @param holder The address whose rewards are claimed.
    /// @param vTokens The vToken markets to claim in.
    function claimVenus(address holder, address[] calldata vTokens) external;

    /// @notice Get the XVS token address.
    /// @return address The XVS token.
    function getXVSAddress() external view returns (address);
}

/**
 * @title IHubLiquidity
 * @author Venus
 * @notice Minimal views and emergency levers HubNavDeviationSentinel and EBrake need from the
 *         Liquidity Hub.
 * @dev Hand-copied so this repo takes no dependency on liquidity-hub. Nothing cross-checks the
 *      selectors at build time, so a signature that drifts from the Hub's reverts on chain.
 */
interface IHub {
    /// @notice Per-YieldGroup configuration held by the Hub's registry.
    /// @param absoluteCap Hard cap on the YieldGroup's holdings, in asset units.
    /// @param percentageCapBps Cap as a fraction of `totalAssets()`, in basis points.
    /// @param paused When true, routing skips this YieldGroup; existing balance still counts.
    /// @param registered True iff present in the Hub's YieldGroup registry.
    struct YieldGroupConfig {
        uint256 absoluteCap;
        uint16 percentageCapBps;
        bool paused;
        bool registered;
    }

    /// @notice Pause the Hub, halting deposits and redemptions.
    /// @dev ACM role `"pauseHub()"`. Idempotent — pausing an already-paused Hub is a silent no-op.
    function pauseHub() external;

    /// @notice Stop the Hub routing new deposits to a YieldGroup; its balance still counts toward NAV.
    /// @dev ACM role `"pauseYieldGroup(address)"`. Idempotent, and reverts `YieldGroupNotRegistered`
    ///      for an address the Hub never registered.
    /// @param yieldGroup YieldGroup to pause.
    function pauseYieldGroup(address yieldGroup) external;

    /// @notice Read a YieldGroup's registry entry.
    /// @param yieldGroup YieldGroup to read.
    /// @return config Stored configuration; all-zero when never registered.
    function yieldGroupConfig(address yieldGroup) external view returns (YieldGroupConfig memory config);

    /// @notice Whether the Hub is currently paused.
    /// @return paused True while the Hub is paused.
    function hubPaused() external view returns (bool paused);
}

/**
 * @title IHubRegistry
 * @author Venus
 * @notice The chain-level Hub directory, as far as HubNavDeviationSentinel needs it.
 * @dev One per chain, and only on chains that run a Liquidity Hub. Governance writes it, so it
 *      answers whether an address is a Hub Venus onboarded rather than one that claims to be.
 */
interface IHubRegistry {
    /// @notice Whether an address is a registered Hub.
    /// @param hub Address to check.
    /// @return registered True iff the registry lists `hub`.
    function isHub(address hub) external view returns (bool registered);
}

/**
 * @title IYieldGroupNav
 * @author Venus
 * @notice The registry and NavGuard reads HubNavDeviationSentinel needs from a YieldGroup, and the
 *         resource pause EBrake forwards to it.
 */
interface IYieldGroupNav {
    /// @notice A resource's NavGuard band, as stored by the YieldGroup.
    /// @param anchor Value the two gaps are sized off.
    /// @param centre Where the band sits: the anchor plus Venus's own deposits since.
    /// @param anchoredAt When the band last re-anchored.
    /// @param driftFrom When the drift clock last restarted.
    /// @param interval Seconds between re-anchors; `0` means no band is configured.
    /// @param driftBps Annual drift allowance, in basis points.
    /// @param upGapBps How far above the centre the band reaches, in basis points of the anchor.
    /// @param downGapBps How far below the centre the band reaches, in basis points of the anchor.
    /// @param capEnabled Whether the Hub holds its valuation to the cap.
    /// @param floorEnabled Whether the Hub holds its valuation to the floor.
    struct NavBand {
        uint128 anchor;
        uint128 centre;
        uint64 anchoredAt;
        uint64 driftFrom;
        uint32 interval;
        uint16 driftBps;
        uint16 upGapBps;
        uint16 downGapBps;
        bool capEnabled;
        bool floorEnabled;
    }

    /// @notice The Hub this YieldGroup reports assets to.
    /// @dev Written once in the YieldGroup's initializer, so HubNavDeviationSentinel can derive the Hub
    ///      from the YieldGroup instead of having a keeper name it.
    /// @return hubAddress Hub that owns this YieldGroup.
    function hub() external view returns (address hubAddress);

    /// @notice Per-resource registration / pause state plus the adapter handling it.
    /// @param resource Address to look up.
    /// @return registered True iff present in the YieldGroup's resource registry.
    /// @return paused True iff this resource is paused.
    /// @return adapter `IResourceAdapter` implementation bound to this resource.
    function resourceConfig(address resource) external view returns (bool registered, bool paused, address adapter);

    /// @notice Stop the YieldGroup routing new deposits to a resource; its balance still counts
    ///         toward NAV, but user withdrawals skip it.
    /// @dev ACM role `"pauseResource(address)"`, checked against this YieldGroup's address. Idempotent,
    ///      and reverts `ResourceNotRegistered` for an address the YieldGroup never registered.
    /// @param resource Resource to pause.
    function pauseResource(address resource) external;

    /// @notice The band's own stored numbers for a resource.
    /// @dev Field order must match the Hub's `NavBand` exactly. `anchor` and `centre` are both
    ///      `uint128` and adjacent, so a reordering there would decode silently wrong rather than
    ///      revert — pin this against `INavGuard.NavBand` when upgrading either side.
    ///
    ///      `centre` is the value as last saved, on a deposit, redeem or re-anchor. The Hub grows it
    ///      by `driftBps` a year since `driftFrom`, so a caller wanting the live centre must too.
    /// @param resource Resource to look up.
    /// @return band The stored band.
    function navGuard(address resource) external view returns (NavBand memory band);

    /// @notice Where a resource's value stands against its NavGuard band right now.
    /// @dev Never reverts. A zero `observedValue` is ambiguous on purpose: the Hub reads the value
    ///      source as `(value, readable)` and drops the flag here, so a read that failed and a
    ///      position the counterparty prices at nothing arrive identically. The Hub values the
    ///      position at 0 in both cases, which is why HubNavDeviationSentinel pauses on either when
    ///      the band is open.
    /// @param resource Resource to read.
    /// @return observedValue Value the counterparty reports, in asset units; `0` if unreadable or genuinely zero.
    /// @return minAllowedValue Lowest value the band allows right now.
    /// @return maxAllowedValue Highest value the band allows right now.
    /// @return isClamped Whether valuation is currently reporting a bound instead of `observedValue`.
    /// @return clampedValue What valuation reports instead; `0` when `isClamped` is false.
    function navGuardStatus(
        address resource
    )
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint256 observedValue,
            uint256 minAllowedValue,
            uint256 maxAllowedValue,
            bool isClamped,
            uint256 clampedValue
        );
}

/**
 * @title ISmartDCA
 * @author Venus
 * @notice Types, events, errors and external functions of SmartDCA. Every function is documented here; the contract
 *         only inherits the docs.
 * @dev Every amount in SmartDCA is one of four kinds, and its name says which:
 *      - Token amount (`stableAmount`, `assetAmount`): wei of a token, for example USDT or BTCB.
 *      - Source share (`sharesHeld`): what SmartDCA holds in a yield source, a Hub share or a Core vToken.
 *      - Unit (`stableUnits`, `assetUnits`): a plan's claim on SmartDCA's shares of one token. Interest raises the
 *        value of a unit, never the number of units, so a plan's units only change when it deposits or is paid.
 *      - Principal (`principal`): stable a plan deposited for one buy, PRD letter B. The fee is only taken on what
 *        a buy redeems above its principal, so it never touches principal.
 *
 *      Other terms:
 *      - Stable: the token a plan pays with (USDT, USDC, U). Asset: the token it buys (BTCB, ETH, WBNB).
 *      - Pair: one stable and one asset. Each pair has its own rounds.
 *      - Round: one monthly buy of a pair. Round `r` is month `anchorMonth + r`; it starts (locks) on the 15th at
 *        00:00 UTC+8, and from then the keeper redeems, swaps and settles it.
 *      - Schedule: the buys a plan has left. A top up restarts the schedule over the buys left, so a plan stores
 *        its current schedule and, apart from it, what it bought before.
 */
interface ISmartDCA {
    /// @notice Kind of yield source a token waits and earns in
    /// @param None No source set yet. This is the empty value; the admin can never set it.
    /// @param Hub A Venus Liquidity Hub vault
    /// @param Core A Core Pool vToken market
    enum SourceKind {
        None,
        Hub,
        Core
    }

    /// @notice Side of a pair: the stable it sells or the asset it buys. Each side has its own yield source.
    /// @param Stable The stable the plan sells, for example USDT
    /// @param Asset The token the plan buys, for example BTCB
    enum Side {
        Stable,
        Asset
    }

    /// @notice Stored plan status. A plan is Matured when it is Active and every buy has settled; that is computed,
    ///         not stored.
    /// @param None No plan with this id. This is the empty value.
    /// @param Active Open: buying, or done buying and waiting to be claimed
    /// @param Cancelled Ended early. The owner was paid the stable left and the asset bought so far.
    /// @param Claimed Ended after the last buy. The owner was paid the asset bought.
    enum PlanStatus {
        None,
        Active,
        Cancelled,
        Claimed
    }

    /**
     * @notice Where one side of one pair waits and earns, and how much SmartDCA holds there for it
     * @dev Kept per pair, so two pairs with the same stable can use different sources, and moving one pair's source
     *      leaves the other pairs alone.
     * @param kind Hub or Core
     * @param sourceAddress The Liquidity Hub, or the Core vToken
     * @param sharesHeld Source shares SmartDCA holds for this pair side, counted in storage so donations are ignored
     * @param unitsIssued Units of this pair side owed to plans and rounds. One unit is backed by
     *        `sharesHeld / unitsIssued` shares.
     */
    struct YieldSource {
        SourceKind kind;
        address sourceAddress;
        uint256 sharesHeld;
        uint256 unitsIssued;
    }

    /**
     * @notice A stable to asset pair and the totals of its next round
     * @param stable Token sold
     * @param asset Token bought
     * @param enabled False stops new plans and top ups; running plans keep buying
     * @param lastSettledRound Last round that settled. The pair's next round is `lastSettledRound + 1`.
     * @param lockEmittedRound Last round `RoundLocked` was emitted for
     * @param roundStableUnits Stable units the next round sells: the sum of `stableUnitsPerBuy` over its plans
     * @param roundPrincipal Principal of the next round: the sum of `principalPerBuy` over its plans
     * @param assetPerUnitIndex Asset units bought per stable unit sold, summed over every settled round, scaled 1e36
     * @param assetPerPrincipalIndex Asset units bought per wei of principal, summed over every settled round, scaled
     *        1e36. It only grows in rounds that redeemed more than their principal with a fee rate above 0.
     */
    struct Pair {
        address stable;
        address asset;
        bool enabled;
        uint32 lastSettledRound;
        uint32 lockEmittedRound;
        uint256 roundStableUnits;
        uint256 roundPrincipal;
        uint256 assetPerUnitIndex;
        uint256 assetPerPrincipalIndex;
    }

    /**
     * @notice One round of a pair
     * @param partsTotal Parts the round is split into; 0 until `startRound`
     * @param partsDone Parts swapped so far
     * @param resplitUsed Whether `resplitRound` was called
     * @param feeRateBps Fee rate the round charged, in basis points; 0 when it redeemed no more than its principal
     * @param stableRedeemed Stable amount `startRound` redeemed for the round's stable units
     * @param stableNet `stableRedeemed` less the fee: the stable amount the round swaps
     * @param stableToSwap Part of `stableNet` not swapped yet
     * @param assetBought Asset amount the swaps returned so far
     * @param stableUnitsJoining Stable units per buy of plans whose first round is the one after this. They are
     *        added to the pair's totals when this round settles.
     * @param principalJoining Principal per buy of the same plans
     * @param stableUnitsEnding Stable units per buy of plans whose last buy is this round. They are removed from the
     *        pair's totals when this round settles.
     * @param principalEnding Principal per buy of the same plans
     * @param assetPerUnitIndexAfter `Pair.assetPerUnitIndex` once this round settled
     * @param assetPerPrincipalIndexAfter `Pair.assetPerPrincipalIndex` once this round settled
     */
    struct Round {
        uint8 partsTotal;
        uint8 partsDone;
        bool resplitUsed;
        uint16 feeRateBps;
        uint256 stableRedeemed;
        uint256 stableNet;
        uint256 stableToSwap;
        uint256 assetBought;
        uint256 stableUnitsJoining;
        uint256 principalJoining;
        uint256 stableUnitsEnding;
        uint256 principalEnding;
        uint256 assetPerUnitIndexAfter;
        uint256 assetPerPrincipalIndexAfter;
    }

    /**
     * @notice A pair's PancakeSwap V3 route for `forceBuy`, set by governance
     * @param router PancakeSwap V3 SwapRouter; zero means the pair has no route and `forceBuy` reverts
     * @param path Pools from the stable to the asset, packed as `stable, fee, asset` or with more hops
     */
    struct FallbackRoute {
        address router;
        bytes path;
    }

    /**
     * @notice A plan. Round calls never write it; its progress is read from the pair and round records.
     * @dev A top up restarts the schedule: what was bought so far moves to `assetUnitsCarried`, and the `schedule`
     *      fields then describe only the buys still left. The plan's buys in total are
     *      `buysBeforeSchedule + scheduleBuys`.
     * @param owner Plan owner, the only account that can act on it
     * @param pairId Pair the plan buys on
     * @param status Stored status
     * @param scheduleBuys Buys in the current schedule
     * @param buysBeforeSchedule Buys that settled before the current schedule started
     * @param scheduleFirstRound First round of the current schedule
     * @param scheduleStableUnits Stable units the plan held when the current schedule started
     * @param stableUnitsPerBuy Stable units sold in each buy, `scheduleStableUnits / scheduleBuys` rounded down
     * @param principalPerBuy Principal in each buy (PRD B)
     * @param assetUnitsCarried Asset units bought before the current schedule started
     * @param assetUnitsPaid Asset units paid out by `withdrawBought`, `cancelPlan` and `claimPlan`
     */
    struct Plan {
        address owner;
        uint32 pairId;
        PlanStatus status;
        uint8 scheduleBuys;
        uint8 buysBeforeSchedule;
        uint32 scheduleFirstRound;
        uint256 scheduleStableUnits;
        uint256 stableUnitsPerBuy;
        uint256 principalPerBuy;
        uint256 assetUnitsCarried;
        uint256 assetUnitsPaid;
    }

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when a plan is created
     * @param planId The new plan
     * @param owner Owner of the plan
     * @param pairId Pair the plan buys on
     * @param stableAmount Stable amount received
     * @param stableUnits Stable units minted for `stableAmount`
     * @param stableUnitsPerBuy Stable units sold in each buy
     * @param principalPerBuy Principal in each buy
     * @param buys Number of buys
     * @param firstRound First round the plan buys in
     */
    event PlanCreated(
        uint256 indexed planId,
        address indexed owner,
        uint32 indexed pairId,
        uint256 stableAmount,
        uint256 stableUnits,
        uint256 stableUnitsPerBuy,
        uint256 principalPerBuy,
        uint8 buys,
        uint32 firstRound
    );

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when a plan is topped up; its schedule restarts with `buysLeft` buys
     * @param planId The plan
     * @param stableAmount Stable amount received
     * @param stableUnits Stable units minted for `stableAmount`
     * @param stableUnitsPerBuy New stable units sold in each buy
     * @param principalPerBuy New principal in each buy
     * @param buysLeft Buys in the restarted schedule
     */
    event PlanToppedUp(
        uint256 indexed planId,
        uint256 stableAmount,
        uint256 stableUnits,
        uint256 stableUnitsPerBuy,
        uint256 principalPerBuy,
        uint8 buysLeft
    );

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when bought asset is withdrawn from an active plan
     * @param planId The plan
     * @param receiver Address paid
     * @param assetUnits Asset units taken from the plan
     * @param toCore True when paid as the asset's Core vToken, false when paid as the asset
     * @param amount vTokens or asset amount paid to `receiver`
     */
    event BoughtWithdrawn(
        uint256 indexed planId,
        address indexed receiver,
        uint256 assetUnits,
        bool toCore,
        uint256 amount
    );

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when a plan is cancelled
     * @param planId The plan
     * @param receiver Address paid
     * @param stableAmount Stable amount paid to `receiver`, after `fee`
     * @param fee Stable amount sent to the Reserve
     * @param toCore True when the bought asset was paid as the asset's Core vToken, false when paid as the asset
     * @param assetAmount vTokens or asset amount paid to `receiver`
     */
    event PlanCancelled(
        uint256 indexed planId,
        address indexed receiver,
        uint256 stableAmount,
        uint256 fee,
        bool toCore,
        uint256 assetAmount
    );

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when a matured plan is claimed
     * @param planId The plan
     * @param receiver Address paid
     * @param toCore True when paid as the asset's Core vToken, false when paid as the asset
     * @param amount vTokens or asset amount paid to `receiver`

    event PlanClaimed(uint256 indexed planId, address indexed receiver, bool toCore, uint256 amount);

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when a plan moves to a new owner
     * @param planId The plan
     * @param from Previous owner
     * @param to New owner

    event PlanTransferred(uint256 indexed planId, address indexed from, address indexed to);

    /**
     * @notice Emitted once per round that has plans to buy for, by the first of `createPlan`, `claimPlan`,
     *         `startRound`, `forceBuy` or `syncPair` called on the pair from the round's lock time. An empty round
     *         emits only `RoundSettled`.
     * @param pairId The pair
     * @param round The round that locked
     */
    event RoundLocked(uint32 indexed pairId, uint32 indexed round);

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when a round redeems its stable and takes its fee
     * @param pairId The pair
     * @param round The round
     * @param parts Parts the round is split into
     * @param roundStableUnits Stable units redeemed
     * @param stableRedeemed Stable amount received for them
     * @param roundPrincipal Principal of the round's plans; the fee is taken on `stableRedeemed` above it
     * @param feeRateBps Fee rate charged, in basis points; 0 when `stableRedeemed` is not above `roundPrincipal`
     * @param stableNet Stable amount left to swap after the fee
     */
    event RoundStarted(
        uint32 indexed pairId,
        uint32 indexed round,
        uint8 parts,
        uint256 roundStableUnits,
        uint256 stableRedeemed,
        uint256 roundPrincipal,
        uint16 feeRateBps,
        uint256 stableNet
    );

    /**
     * @notice Emitted for each swapped part of a round
     * @param pairId The pair
     * @param round The round
     * @param part Number of the part, from 1
     * @param stableIn Stable amount sold
     * @param assetOut Asset amount received
     * @param quotedOut Asset amount the keeper's quote promised for `stableIn`, or in `forceBuy` its oracle value
     * @param minOut Least asset amount allowed: `quotedOut` less `maxSlippageBps`, or in `forceBuy` less
     *        `fallbackSlippageBps`
     */
    event RoundPartSwapped(
        uint32 indexed pairId,
        uint32 indexed round,
        uint8 part,
        uint256 stableIn,
        uint256 assetOut,
        uint256 quotedOut,
        uint256 minOut
    );

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when the parts left of a round are split again
     * @param pairId The pair
     * @param round The round
     * @param partsDone Parts already swapped
     * @param newParts Parts the rest is split into
     */
    event RoundResplit(uint32 indexed pairId, uint32 indexed round, uint8 partsDone, uint8 newParts);

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when a round settles. A round with nothing to buy settles with every amount 0.
     * @param pairId The pair
     * @param round The round
     * @param stableRedeemed Stable amount the round redeemed
     * @param fee Stable amount the round sent to the Reserve
     * @param assetBought Asset amount the round bought
     * @param assetUnits Asset units minted for `assetBought`
     * @param assetPerUnitIndex `Pair.assetPerUnitIndex` after the round
     * @param assetPerPrincipalIndex `Pair.assetPerPrincipalIndex` after the round
     */
    event RoundSettled(
        uint32 indexed pairId,
        uint32 indexed round,
        uint256 stableRedeemed,
        uint256 fee,
        uint256 assetBought,
        uint256 assetUnits,
        uint256 assetPerUnitIndex,
        uint256 assetPerPrincipalIndex
    );

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when a round sends its fee to the Reserve
     * @param pairId The pair
     * @param round The round
     * @param amount Stable amount sent
     */
    event RoundFeeCollected(uint32 indexed pairId, uint32 indexed round, uint256 amount);

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when a cancel sends its fee to the Reserve
     * @param pairId The plan's pair
     * @param planId The cancelled plan
     * @param amount Stable amount sent
     */
    event CancelFeeCollected(uint32 indexed pairId, uint256 indexed planId, uint256 amount);

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when XVS rewards are claimed and sent to the Reserve
     * @param amount XVS sent
     */
    event RewardsClaimed(uint256 amount);

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when governance adds a pair
     * @param pairId The new pair
     * @param stable Token sold
     * @param asset Token bought
     */
    event PairAdded(uint32 indexed pairId, address indexed stable, address indexed asset);

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when a pair is enabled or disabled
     * @param pairId The pair
     * @param enabled True when new plans and top ups are allowed
     */
    event PairEnabledUpdated(uint32 indexed pairId, bool enabled);

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when the yield source of one side of a pair is set
     * @param pairId The pair
     * @param side Stable or Asset
     * @param oldSource Previous source, 0 when none
     * @param kind Kind of the new source
     * @param newSource New source
     * @param migratedAmount Token amount moved from the old source to the new one
     */
    event YieldSourceUpdated(
        uint32 indexed pairId,
        Side side,
        address oldSource,
        SourceKind kind,
        address newSource,
        uint256 migratedAmount
    );

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when the fee rate changes
     * @param oldFeeRateBps Previous rate, in basis points
     * @param newFeeRateBps New rate, in basis points
     */
    event FeeRateUpdated(uint16 oldFeeRateBps, uint16 newFeeRateBps);

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when the fee rate cap changes
     * @param oldMaxFeeRateBps Previous cap, in basis points
     * @param newMaxFeeRateBps New cap, in basis points
     */
    event MaxFeeRateUpdated(uint16 oldMaxFeeRateBps, uint16 newMaxFeeRateBps);

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when the slippage bound changes
     * @param oldMaxSlippageBps Previous bound, in basis points
     * @param newMaxSlippageBps New bound, in basis points
     */
    event MaxSlippageUpdated(uint16 oldMaxSlippageBps, uint16 newMaxSlippageBps);

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when the most a keeper swap's `minOut` can be below the oracle changes
     * @param oldMaxOracleDeviationBps Previous value, in basis points
     * @param newMaxOracleDeviationBps New value, in basis points
     */
    event MaxOracleDeviationUpdated(uint16 oldMaxOracleDeviationBps, uint16 newMaxOracleDeviationBps);

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when the most parts one `startRound` or `resplitRound` call can split a round into changes
     * @param oldMaxParts Previous value
     * @param newMaxParts New value
     */
    event MaxPartsUpdated(uint8 oldMaxParts, uint8 newMaxParts);

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when a stable's least amount per buy changes
     * @param stable The stable
     * @param oldAmount Previous minimum, in the stable's decimals
     * @param newAmount New minimum, in the stable's decimals
     */
    event MinAmountPerBuyUpdated(address indexed stable, uint256 oldAmount, uint256 newAmount);

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when the allowed number of buys for a new plan changes
     * @param oldMinBuys Previous fewest buys
     * @param oldMaxBuys Previous most buys
     * @param newMinBuys New fewest buys
     * @param newMaxBuys New most buys
     */
    event BuyBoundsUpdated(uint8 oldMinBuys, uint8 oldMaxBuys, uint8 newMinBuys, uint8 newMaxBuys);

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when a keeper is added or removed
     * @param account The keeper
     * @param allowed True when added
     */
    event KeeperUpdated(address indexed account, bool allowed);

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when the Reserve address changes
     * @param oldReserve Previous Reserve
     * @param newReserve New Reserve
     */
    event ReserveUpdated(address oldReserve, address newReserve);

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when tokens not owed to plans or rounds are swept
     * @param token The token
     * @param to Receiver
     * @param amount Amount sent
     */
    event TokenSwept(address indexed token, address indexed to, uint256 amount);

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when a pair's `forceBuy` route is set
     * @param pairId The pair
     * @param router PancakeSwap V3 SwapRouter, zero to remove the route
     * @param path Packed pool path from the stable to the asset
     */
    event FallbackRouteUpdated(uint32 indexed pairId, address router, bytes path);

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when the `forceBuy` slippage bound changes
     * @param oldSlippageBps Previous bound, in basis points
     * @param newSlippageBps New bound, in basis points
     */
    event FallbackSlippageUpdated(uint16 oldSlippageBps, uint16 newSlippageBps);

    /**
     * @notice Emitted when a router is added to or removed from the keeper swap allowlist
     * @param router The router
     * @param allowed True when added
     */
    event RouterAllowlisted(address indexed router, bool allowed);

    /// @notice An address argument was zero.
    error ZeroAddress();

    /// @notice An amount was zero, or a round or withdraw would move nothing.
    error ZeroAmount();

    /// @notice No pair has this id.
    error UnknownPair(uint32 pairId);

    /// @notice A pair was added with the same token as stable and asset.
    error SameTokens();

    /// @notice A plan was created or topped up on a disabled pair.
    error PairDisabled();

    /// @notice A pair with this stable and asset already exists.
    error PairExists();

    /// @notice The call to SwapHelper reverted with no reason. A revert with a reason, such as SwapHelper's
    ///         `Unauthorized` or a router error, is passed on as it is.
    error SwapFailed();

    /// @notice A keeper swap calls or approves `router`, which is not on the allowlist.
    error RouterNotAllowed(address router);

    /// @notice The keeper swap data is not a `SwapHelper.multicall`, has a call other than `genericCall`,
    ///         `approveMax` or `sweep`, or sweeps a token other than the pair's stable or asset, or to an address
    ///         other than SmartDCA.
    error SwapCallNotAllowed();

    /// @notice The swap did not sell the whole part: in a keeper swap some of the stable came back to SmartDCA or
    ///         stayed in SwapHelper; in `forceBuy` the router took less than the part.
    error PartNotFullySwapped(uint256 stableIn, uint256 stableSpent);

    /// @notice The yield source is not a registered Hub, or not a listed Core vToken, of the token.
    error InvalidSource(address source);

    /// @notice The yield source is already the source of this pair side.
    error SourceUnchanged();

    /// @notice A pair's stable source cannot move while the pair is past its lock time and not settled.
    error PairLocked(uint32 pairId);

    /// @notice A round function was called before `startsAt`: the round's start for the keeper, or 24 h later for
    ///         `forceBuy`.
    error RoundNotStarted(uint256 startsAt);

    /// @notice The round function needs `startRound` to have run for the round, and it has not.
    error StartRoundNotCalled(uint32 pairId);

    /// @notice `startRound` already ran for the pair's next round.
    error RoundAlreadyStarted(uint32 pairId);

    /// @notice The caller is not a keeper.
    error NotRoundCaller(address caller);

    /// @notice The number of parts is 0 or above `maxParts`.
    error InvalidParts();

    /// @notice Every part of the round is already swapped.
    error NoPartsLeft();

    /// @notice The round cannot settle while it has parts left to swap.
    error PartsLeft();

    /// @notice The round was already resplit once.
    error AlreadyResplit();

    /// @notice The swap returned less than `minOut`: the keeper's quote less `maxSlippageBps` in a keeper swap, or the
    ///         oracle value of the part less `fallbackSlippageBps` in `forceBuy`.
    error SlippageExceeded(uint256 assetOut, uint256 minOut);

    /// @notice A keeper swap's `minOut` is more than `maxOracleDeviationBps` below the oracle value of the part.
    error QuoteBelowOracle(uint256 minOut, uint256 floor);

    /// @notice The number of buys is outside `minBuys` to `maxBuys`.
    error InvalidBuys(uint8 buys, uint8 minBuys, uint8 maxBuys);

    /// @notice The stable received is under `minAmountPerBuy` times the buys, or too small to sell one unit per buy.
    error DepositTooSmall(uint256 received, uint256 minimum);

    /// @notice The caller does not own the plan.
    error NotPlanOwner();

    /// @notice The plan is cancelled or claimed.
    error PlanNotActive();

    /// @notice The plan is in a round past its lock time that has not settled.
    error PlanInRunningRound();

    /// @notice Every buy of the plan has settled, so it can only be claimed.
    error PlanMatured();

    /// @notice The plan still has buys to settle.
    error PlanNotMatured();

    /// @notice The withdraw asks for more asset units than the plan has bought.
    error WithdrawExceedsBought(uint256 requestedUnits, uint256 availableUnits);

    /// @notice A withdraw, claim or cancel paid as vTokens was asked for while the asset is not held in Core.
    error NotCoreSource();

    /// @notice A Core vToken returned a non-zero error code.
    error SourceCallFailed(address source, uint256 errorCode);

    /// @notice A parameter is above its hard cap.
    error AboveHardCap();

    /// @notice A parameter is outside its allowed range.
    error InvalidParameter();

    /// @notice `forceBuy` was called on a pair with no route.
    error NoFallbackRoute(uint32 pairId);

    /**
     * @notice Deposits `amount` of the pair's stable and starts a plan of `buys` monthly buys, owned by `owner`.
     * @dev The caller pays and must first `approve` SmartDCA for `amount` of the stable; `owner` can be another
     *      address, so a contract can open a plan for a user. The deposit goes into the pair's stable
     *      source and the plan holds units of it. Each buy sells the same number of units, so a buy's stable amount
     *      grows with the interest earned while waiting.
     *
     *      The plan's first round is the pair's next round when called before that round's lock time, and the round
     *      after it from the lock time on. During an overrun (a round still running past the next 15th) that is the
     *      round right after the running one, not the calendar month.
     *
     *      Reverts if `owner` is the zero address, if the pair is unknown or disabled, if `buys` is outside `minBuys`
     *      to `maxBuys`, or if the stable received is under `minAmountPerBuy` of the stable times `buys`. The stable
     *      received is counted as a balance change, so for a token that charges a transfer fee it is below `amount`.
     * @param pairId Pair to buy on
     * @param amount Stable amount to deposit, in the stable's decimals
     * @param buys Number of monthly buys
     * @param owner Owner of the new plan
     * @return planId The new plan
     * @custom:event Emits RoundSettled for each empty round it settles first, RoundLocked on the first call of a
     *      locked round, and PlanCreated.
     */
    function createPlan(uint32 pairId, uint256 amount, uint8 buys, address owner) external returns (uint256 planId);

    /**
     * @notice Adds `amount` of stable to a plan and spreads everything still waiting over the buys left.
     * @dev Caller must own the plan and first `approve` SmartDCA for `amount`. The schedule restarts: what was bought
     *      so far is kept aside, and the stable still waiting plus the new deposit is split evenly over the buys left.
     *
     *      Reverts if the plan is in a round past its lock time that has not settled, if every buy has settled, if
     *      the pair is disabled, or if the stable received, counted as a balance change, is under `minAmountPerBuy`
     *      times the buys left.
     * @param planId The plan
     * @param amount Stable amount to add, in the stable's decimals
     * @custom:event Emits RoundSettled for each empty round it settles first, and PlanToppedUp.
     */
    function topUpPlan(uint256 planId, uint256 amount) external;

    /**
     * @notice Pays `receiver` `amount` of the asset bought so far, or all of it with `type(uint256).max`.
     * @dev Allowed while the plan's round is running: a running round's buy only counts once it settles. A partial
     *      amount is converted to units rounded up, so `receiver` gets at least `amount`, unless Core takes a
     *      redeem fee (`treasuryPercent`). Only the owner can call.
     *
     *      With `toCore`, the asset is paid as the asset's Core vTokens worth at least `amount`, and no redeem fee
     *      applies; reverts with `NotCoreSource` if the asset side is not in Core. Use it when Core cannot redeem the
     *      asset, for example with too little cash or redeem paused.
     * @param planId The plan
     * @param amount Asset amount to withdraw, in the asset's decimals, also with `toCore`
     * @param toCore True to pay as vTokens, false to pay as the asset
     * @param receiver Address paid
     * @custom:event Emits BoughtWithdrawn.
     */
    function withdrawBought(uint256 planId, uint256 amount, bool toCore, address receiver) external;

    /**
     * @notice Ends a plan. Pays `receiver` the stable still waiting, less the fee on its interest, and all bought
     *         asset.
     * @dev The fee is `feeRateBps` of what the waiting stable redeems above its principal, so a cancel never takes a
     *      fee from principal. Reverts if the plan is in a round past its lock time that has not settled, or if
     *      every buy has settled (claim it instead).
     *
     *      With `toCore`, the bought asset is paid as the asset's Core vTokens; reverts with `NotCoreSource` if the
     *      asset side is not in Core and the plan has bought asset. Use it when Core cannot redeem the asset, for
     *      example with too little cash or redeem paused: without `toCore` the whole cancel reverts, the stable too.
     * @param planId The plan
     * @param toCore True to pay the bought asset as vTokens, false to pay it as the asset
     * @param receiver Address paid
     * @custom:event Emits RoundSettled for each empty round it settles first, CancelFeeCollected when the fee is
     *      not zero, and PlanCancelled.
     */
    function cancelPlan(uint256 planId, bool toCore, address receiver) external;

    /**
     * @notice Pays `receiver` the asset of a plan whose buys have all settled, and closes it.
     * @dev With `toCore`, `receiver` gets the asset's Core vTokens and keeps earning; collateral is not enabled for
     *      them. Up to `scheduleBuys - 1` stable units are left by rounding the per-buy amount down and are dropped
     *      here; each is worth about one share of the first source the stable side used (under 1 wei for a Hub,
     *      about 2e8 wei for a Core vToken).
     *
     *      With `toCore`, reverts with `NotCoreSource` if the asset side is not in Core.
     * @param planId The plan
     * @param toCore True to pay as vTokens, false to pay as the asset
     * @param receiver Address paid
     * @custom:event Emits RoundSettled for each empty round it settles first, RoundLocked on the first call of a
     *      locked round, and PlanClaimed.
     */
    function claimPlan(uint256 planId, bool toCore, address receiver) external;

    /**
     * @notice Gives an active plan to `newOwner`, who can then top it up, withdraw, cancel and claim it.
     * @dev Only the owner changes; no funds or round totals move, so it works during a lock too.
     * @param planId The plan
     * @param newOwner The new owner
     * @custom:event Emits PlanTransferred.
     */
    function transferPlan(uint256 planId, address newOwner) external;

    /**
     * @notice Starts the pair's next round: redeems its stable units from the yield source and sends the fee to the
     *         Reserve.
     * @dev Keepers can call from the round's lock time.
     *      Rounds with nothing to buy are settled first. If the round after them is not locked yet, the call returns
     *      with nothing done.
     *
     *      The fee is `feeRateBps` of what the round redeems above its principal, and the rate is fixed for the
     *      round here. Reverts if the round already started, or if the redeem returns nothing.
     * @param pairId The pair
     * @param parts Parts to split the swap into, 1 to `maxParts`
     * @custom:event Emits RoundSettled for each empty round it settles first, RoundLocked on the first call of a
     *      locked round, RoundFeeCollected when the fee is not zero, and RoundStarted.
     */
    function startRound(uint32 pairId, uint8 parts) external;

    /**
     * @notice Swaps the next part of the running round through SwapHelper.
     * @dev Each part sells an even share of what is left, `stableToSwap / parts left`, so the last part sells the
     *      rest. `quotedOut` less `maxSlippageBps` is the swap's `minOut`, and it may be at most
     *      `maxOracleDeviationBps` below the oracle value of the part (`QuoteBelowOracle`). The swap must return at
     *      least `minOut`, and the whole part must be sold:
     *      no stable may come back to SmartDCA or stay in SwapHelper. Every `genericCall` target and `approveMax`
     *      spender in the multicall must be on `allowedRouters`, and every `sweep` must send the pair's stable or
     *      asset to SmartDCA.
     * @param pairId The pair
     * @param quotedOut Fresh quote for this part's stable, in the asset's decimals, with pool fees already taken;
     *        must not be 0
     * @param swapData `SwapHelper.multicall` calldata built off chain for this part and signed for SmartDCA as the
     *        caller. It must sell the part's stable and send the asset to SmartDCA.
     * @custom:event Emits RoundPartSwapped.
     */
    function swapRoundPart(uint32 pairId, uint256 quotedOut, bytes calldata swapData) external;

    /**
     * @notice Splits the parts left of the running round into `parts` new parts. Allowed once per round.
     * @param pairId The pair
     * @param parts New number of parts left, 1 to `maxParts`
     * @custom:event Emits RoundResplit.
     */
    function resplitRound(uint32 pairId, uint8 parts) external;

    /**
     * @notice Settles the running round once every part is swapped: supplies what it bought to the pair's asset
     *         source and moves the pair's indexes, which credits every plan in the round.
     * @dev Reverts while the asset's source refuses the deposit (a Core supply cap or a mint pause); the keeper
     *      retries until it goes through. Rounds with nothing to buy that are already past their lock time are
     *      settled right after.
     * @param pairId The pair
     * @custom:event Emits RoundSettled.
     */
    function settleRound(uint32 pairId) external;

    /**
     * @notice Runs one part of the pair's round without the keeper or the backend: starts the round if needed, swaps
     *         the next part on the pair's PancakeSwap V3 route, and settles the round after its last part.
     * @dev Callable from `FALLBACK_DELAY` (24 h) after the round's start until it settles; before that it reverts with
     *      `RoundNotStarted`, carrying the time it opens. For a crisis such as the keeper or the backend being down. The swap needs no signed route:
     *      it approves only the part's stable, calls the router's `exactInput`, and reverts if the router took less
     *      than the part or if the asset that arrived is below the oracle value of the part less
     *      `fallbackSlippageBps`. `parts = 1` runs the whole round in one call; a large round can take more parts, sent
     *      apart, so each one moves the pool less. The keeper can keep running the same round, since both share its
     *      part count, and a round whose parts are all swapped only settles. The router is the PancakeSwap V3
     *      SwapRouter, and `fallbackSlippageBps` starts at 0.5%.
     *
     *      On a round that has started, `parts` below the parts left cuts the parts left to `parts`; a higher value
     *      or 0 keeps them. A round the keeper started in 50 parts finishes in one call with `parts = 1`, and calling
     *      again with the same `parts` swaps the next part.
     * @param pairId The pair
     * @param parts Parts to split the round into, 1 to `maxParts`; on a started round, the most parts to leave
     * @custom:access Controlled by AccessControlManager (Guardian)
     * @custom:event On the first part, the events of `startRound`. Then RoundResplit when it cuts the parts left,
     *      RoundPartSwapped, and RoundSettled after the last part.
     */
    function forceBuy(uint32 pairId, uint8 parts) external;

    /**
     * @notice Settles the pair's rounds with nothing to buy, and emits `RoundLocked` once the next round is locked.
     *         Callable by anyone.
     * @param pairId The pair
     * @custom:event Emits RoundSettled for each empty round, and RoundLocked once for the next round with plans.
     */
    function syncPair(uint32 pairId) external;

    /**
     * @notice Claims XVS rewards on `vTokens` and sends them to the Reserve. Callable by anyone.
     * @param vTokens Core markets to claim in
     * @custom:event Emits RewardsClaimed.
     */
    function claimRewards(address[] calldata vTokens) external;

    /**
     * @notice Sets the fee rate on the interest part of each buy and cancel.
     * @param newFeeRateBps New rate in basis points, up to `maxFeeRateBps`
     * @custom:access Controlled by AccessControlManager
     * @custom:event Emits FeeRateUpdated.
     */
    function setFeeRate(uint16 newFeeRateBps) external;

    /**
     * @notice Sets the cap on the fee rate.
     * @param newMaxFeeRateBps New cap in basis points, up to 10,000 (100%) and not below the current fee rate
     * @custom:access Controlled by AccessControlManager
     * @custom:event Emits MaxFeeRateUpdated.
     */
    function setMaxFeeRate(uint16 newMaxFeeRateBps) external;

    /**
     * @notice Sets how far below the keeper's quote a swap can return.
     * @param newMaxSlippageBps New bound in basis points, up to `MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS`
     * @custom:access Controlled by AccessControlManager
     * @custom:event Emits MaxSlippageUpdated.
     */
    function setMaxSlippage(uint16 newMaxSlippageBps) external;

    /**
     * @notice Sets how far below the oracle value of a part a keeper swap's `minOut` can be.
     * @dev 10,000 turns the check off, and the oracle is then not read.
     * @param newMaxOracleDeviationBps New value in basis points, up to 10,000
     * @custom:access Controlled by AccessControlManager
     * @custom:event Emits MaxOracleDeviationUpdated.
     */
    function setMaxOracleDeviation(uint16 newMaxOracleDeviationBps) external;

    /**
     * @notice Sets the most parts one `startRound` or `resplitRound` call can split a round into.
     * @param newMaxParts New value, 1 to `MAX_PARTS`
     * @custom:access Controlled by AccessControlManager
     * @custom:event Emits MaxPartsUpdated.
     */
    function setMaxParts(uint8 newMaxParts) external;

    /**
     * @notice Pauses every user and round call. Views, admin setters and `claimRewards` keep working.
     * @custom:access Controlled by AccessControlManager
     * @custom:event Emits Paused.
     */
    function pause() external;

    /**
     * @notice Sets where one side of a pair waits and earns, and moves that pair side's holdings there in the same
     *         call. Other pairs with the same token keep their own source.
     * @dev Plans hold units, and the move keeps the number of units, so no plan changes. A stable side that holds
     *      shares cannot move from its next round's lock time until that round settles (`PairLocked`); an asset
     *      move can, as a running round holds its bought asset as tokens. Empty rounds whose lock time has passed
     *      are settled first, so they do not block the move. Works while paused.
     * @param pairId The pair
     * @param side Stable or Asset
     * @param kind Hub or Core
     * @param source A Hub registered in the Hub registry for the side's token, or a Core vToken listed in the
     *        Comptroller whose underlying is that token
     * @custom:access Controlled by AccessControlManager
     * @custom:event Emits RoundSettled for each empty round it settles first, and YieldSourceUpdated.
     */
    function setYieldSource(uint32 pairId, Side side, SourceKind kind, address source) external;

    /**
     * @notice Adds or removes a keeper. Keepers run rounds from the lock time.
     * @param account The keeper
     * @param allowed True to add, false to remove
     * @custom:access Controlled by AccessControlManager
     * @custom:event Emits KeeperUpdated.
     */
    function setKeeper(address account, bool allowed) external;

    /**
     * @notice Sets the least stable amount per buy for a stable. A plan of `n` buys needs at least `n` times this.
     * @dev Must be set before the stable's first pair is added.
     * @param stable The stable
     * @param newAmount New minimum in the stable's decimals, above 0
     * @custom:access Controlled by AccessControlManager
     * @custom:event Emits MinAmountPerBuyUpdated.
     */
    function setMinAmountPerBuy(address stable, uint256 newAmount) external;

    /**
     * @notice Sets the fewest and most buys a new plan can have. Existing plans do not change.
     * @param newMinBuys Fewest buys, above 0
     * @param newMaxBuys Most buys, at least `newMinBuys` and up to `MAX_BUYS`
     * @custom:access Controlled by AccessControlManager
     * @custom:event Emits BuyBoundsUpdated.
     */
    function setBuyBounds(uint8 newMinBuys, uint8 newMaxBuys) external;

    /**
     * @notice Adds a pair with the yield source of each side. Its first round is the next one to lock.
     * @dev Both tokens need a price in the oracle, and the stable a `minAmountPerBuy`. Each source is checked as in
     *      `setYieldSource`.
     * @param stable Token sold
     * @param asset Token bought
     * @param stableKind Kind of the stable's source, Hub or Core
     * @param stableSource Where the stable waits, a Liquidity Hub at launch
     * @param assetKind Kind of the asset's source, Hub or Core
     * @param assetSource Where the asset bought is held, a Core vToken at launch
     * @return pairId The new pair
     * @custom:access Controlled by AccessControlManager
     * @custom:event Emits PairAdded, then YieldSourceUpdated for each side.
     */
    function addPair(
        address stable,
        address asset,
        SourceKind stableKind,
        address stableSource,
        SourceKind assetKind,
        address assetSource
    ) external returns (uint32 pairId);

    /**
     * @notice Enables or disables new plans and top ups on a pair. Running plans keep buying either way.
     * @param pairId The pair
     * @param enabled True to allow new plans and top ups
     * @custom:access Controlled by AccessControlManager
     * @custom:event Emits PairEnabledUpdated.
     */
    function setPairEnabled(uint32 pairId, bool enabled) external;

    /**
     * @notice Unpauses user and round calls.
     * @custom:access Controlled by AccessControlManager
     * @custom:event Emits Unpaused.
     */
    function unpause() external;

    /**
     * @notice Sends `to` the balance of `token` that is not owed to plans or running rounds.
     * @dev Owed is the source shares held for plans, and the stable or asset a running round holds between
     *      `startRound` and `settleRound`.
     * @param token The token
     * @param to Receiver
     * @custom:access Controlled by AccessControlManager
     * @custom:event Emits TokenSwept.
     */
    function sweepToken(address token, address to) external;

    /**
     * @notice Sets the route `forceBuy` swaps a pair on.
     * @dev Not checked against the pair's tokens: a path that does not start with the stable cannot pull it, and one
     *      that does not end with the asset adds nothing to SmartDCA's asset balance, so the swap reverts either way.
     * @param pairId The pair
     * @param router PancakeSwap V3 SwapRouter, zero to remove the route
     * @param path Packed pool path from the stable to the asset, for example `abi.encodePacked(USDT, 500, BTCB)`
     * @custom:access Controlled by AccessControlManager
     * @custom:event Emits FallbackRouteUpdated.
     */
    function setFallbackRoute(uint32 pairId, address router, bytes calldata path) external;

    /**
     * @notice Sets how far below the oracle price a `forceBuy` swap can return.
     * @param newSlippageBps New bound in basis points, up to `MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS`
     * @custom:access Controlled by AccessControlManager
     * @custom:event Emits FallbackSlippageUpdated.
     */
    function setFallbackSlippage(uint16 newSlippageBps) external;

    /**
     * @notice Adds or removes a router that keeper swaps may call or approve.
     * @param router The router
     * @param allowed True to add, false to remove
     * @custom:access Controlled by AccessControlManager
     * @custom:event Emits RouterAllowlisted.
     */
    function setAllowedRouter(address router, bool allowed) external;

    /**
     * @notice Sets the address that receives fees and rewards.
     * @param newReserve New Reserve
     * @custom:access Controlled by AccessControlManager
     * @custom:event Emits ReserveUpdated.
     */
    function setReserve(address newReserve) external;

    /**
     * @notice Lock time of the round after the pair's last settled round.
     * @dev Read from stored state, so on a pair with empty rounds not settled yet it can be in the past, and a plan
     *      created now joins a later round. An unknown `pairId` returns the lock time of round 1.
     * @param pairId The pair
     * @return Unix timestamp of the 15th at 00:00 UTC+8 of that round's month
     */
    function nextLockTime(uint32 pairId) external view returns (uint256);

    /**
     * @notice Start (lock) time of a round: the 15th at 00:00 UTC+8 of month `anchorMonth + round`.
     * @param round Round number
     * @return Unix timestamp
     */
    function roundStart(uint32 round) external view returns (uint256);

    /**
     * @notice Ids of the plans `owner` holds.
     * @param owner The owner
     * @return Plan ids, including cancelled and claimed plans; a transfer changes their order
     */
    function getPlanIds(address owner) external view returns (uint256[] memory);
}
