pragma solidity 0.8.28;

import { IERC20 } from "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol";
import { Math } from "@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/Math.sol";
import { SafeERC20 } from "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol";
import { ResilientOracleInterface } from "@venusprotocol/oracle/contracts/interfaces/OracleInterface.sol";

import { IHub } from "../CollateralGateway/IHub.sol";
import { IComptroller } from "../Interfaces/IComptroller.sol";
import { IHubRegistry } from "../Interfaces/IHubLiquidity.sol";
import { IPancakeV3SwapRouter } from "../Interfaces/IPancakeV3SwapRouter.sol";
import { IVToken } from "../Interfaces/IVToken.sol";
import { SwapHelper } from "../SwapHelper/SwapHelper.sol";
import { SmartDCAMath } from "./SmartDCAMath.sol";
import { ISmartDCA } from "./ISmartDCA.sol";

/**
 * @title SmartDCAAdminLib
 * @author Venus
 * @notice Bodies of SmartDCA's larger governance, `forceBuy` and keeper swap calls, and the `sweepToken` count, kept
 *         out of SmartDCA to fit the 24,576 byte size limit
 * @dev The external functions run through DELEGATECALL, so they read and write SmartDCA's storage and their events
 *      come from SmartDCA. SmartDCA checks access before calling them. `sourceDeposit` and `sourceRedeem` are
 *      internal, so they are copied into each caller, SmartDCA included.
 */
library SmartDCAAdminLib {
    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;

    /**
     * @notice Records a new pair with its two yield sources
     * @dev Reverts when the oracle cannot price either token
     * @param pair Storage of the new pair
     * @param sources Yield sources of the new pair, by side
     * @param pairId Id of the new pair
     * @param stable Token the pair sells
     * @param asset Token the pair buys
     * @param oracle Oracle that must price both tokens
     * @param hubRegistry Registry Hub sources must be in
     * @param comptroller Comptroller Core sources must be listed in
     * @param stableKind Kind of the stable's source
     * @param stableSource Hub or vToken holding the stable
     * @param assetKind Kind of the asset's source
     * @param assetSource Hub or vToken holding the asset
     */
    function addPair(
        ISmartDCA.Pair storage pair,
        mapping(ISmartDCA.Side => ISmartDCA.YieldSource) storage sources,
        uint32 pairId,
        address stable,
        address asset,
        ResilientOracleInterface oracle,
        IHubRegistry hubRegistry,
        IComptroller comptroller,
        ISmartDCA.SourceKind stableKind,
        address stableSource,
        ISmartDCA.SourceKind assetKind,
        address assetSource
    ) external {
        oracle.getPrice(stable);
        oracle.getPrice(asset);

        pair.stable = stable;
        pair.asset = asset;
        pair.enabled = true;
        emit ISmartDCA.PairAdded(pairId, stable, asset);

        // The pair holds nothing yet, so these only check and record the sources
        setYieldSource(
            pair,
            sources[ISmartDCA.Side.Stable],
            pairId,
            ISmartDCA.Side.Stable,
            stableKind,
            stableSource,
            hubRegistry,
            comptroller,
            false
        );
        setYieldSource(
            pair,
            sources[ISmartDCA.Side.Asset],
            pairId,
            ISmartDCA.Side.Asset,
            assetKind,
            assetSource,
            hubRegistry,
            comptroller,
            false
        );
    }

    /**
     * @notice Sets a pair's `forceBuy` route
     * @param route The pair's route record
     * @param pairId The pair
     * @param router PancakeSwap V3 SwapRouter, zero to remove the route
     * @param path Packed pool path from the stable to the asset
     */
    function setFallbackRoute(
        ISmartDCA.FallbackRoute storage route,
        uint32 pairId,
        address router,
        bytes calldata path
    ) external {
        route.router = router;
        route.path = path;
        emit ISmartDCA.FallbackRouteUpdated(pairId, router, path);
    }

    /**
     * @notice Swaps `stableIn` of the pair's stable for its asset on the pair's route, for `forceBuy`
     * @dev Approves only `stableIn`. Reverts if the router took less than `stableIn`, or if the asset that arrived,
     *      counted as a balance change, is below `minOut`. The router is the PancakeSwap V3 SwapRouter (`exactInput`
     *      with a deadline). It stops without reverting when the pool runs out of liquidity, so a part filled 99.6%
     *      would clear a 0.5% floor; the stable spent check makes it revert.
     * @param route The pair's route
     * @param pair The pair
     * @param oracle Oracle for both tokens' prices
     * @param stableIn Stable amount to sell
     * @param slippageBps Most the swap can return below the oracle value, in basis points
     * @return assetOut Asset amount received
     * @return quotedOut Oracle value of `stableIn` in the asset
     * @return minOut `quotedOut` less `slippageBps`
     */
    function fallbackSwap(
        ISmartDCA.FallbackRoute storage route,
        ISmartDCA.Pair storage pair,
        ResilientOracleInterface oracle,
        uint256 stableIn,
        uint256 slippageBps
    ) external returns (uint256 assetOut, uint256 quotedOut, uint256 minOut) {
        address stable = pair.stable;
        address asset = pair.asset;
        quotedOut = _oracleValue(oracle, stable, asset, stableIn);
        minOut = Math.mulDiv(quotedOut, SmartDCAMath.BPS - slippageBps, SmartDCAMath.BPS);

        uint256 stableBefore = IERC20(stable).balanceOf(address(this));
        uint256 assetBefore = IERC20(asset).balanceOf(address(this));
        IERC20(stable).forceApprove(route.router, stableIn);
        IPancakeV3SwapRouter(route.router).exactInput(
            IPancakeV3SwapRouter.ExactInputParams({
                path: route.path,
                recipient: address(this),
                deadline: block.timestamp,
                amountIn: stableIn,
                amountOutMinimum: minOut
            })
        );
        uint256 stableAfter = IERC20(stable).balanceOf(address(this));
        uint256 stableSpent = stableBefore > stableAfter ? stableBefore - stableAfter : 0;
        if (stableSpent < stableIn) revert ISmartDCA.PartNotFullySwapped(stableIn, stableSpent);
        assetOut = IERC20(asset).balanceOf(address(this)) - assetBefore;
        if (assetOut < minOut) revert ISmartDCA.SlippageExceeded(assetOut, minOut);
    }

    /**
     * @notice Runs a keeper's signed swap of `stableIn` of the pair's stable through SwapHelper, for `swapRoundPart`
     * @dev Same flow as `LeverageStrategiesManager._performSwap`: the signed multicall swaps what SwapHelper holds and
     *      sends the asset back. Reverts if the route makes a call other than `genericCall`, `approveMax` or `sweep`,
     *      touches a router not on `allowedRouters`, sweeps a token other than the pair's stable or asset or sends a
     *      sweep anywhere but SmartDCA, if the swap call reverts, leaves any of the part unsold, or returns less
     *      asset than `minOut`, counted as a balance change.
     *
     *      Before the swap, reverts with `QuoteBelowOracle` if `minOut` is more than `maxOracleDeviationBps` below
     *      the oracle value of `stableIn`. At `maxOracleDeviationBps` = 10,000 the oracle is not read.
     * @param allowedRouters Routers a keeper swap may call or approve
     * @param pair The pair
     * @param swapHelper SwapHelper that runs the multicall
     * @param oracle Oracle that prices both tokens of the pair
     * @param stableIn Stable amount to sell
     * @param minOut Least asset the swap must return
     * @param maxOracleDeviationBps Most `minOut` can be below the oracle value of `stableIn`, in basis points
     * @param swapData The keeper's `SwapHelper.multicall` calldata
     * @return assetOut Asset amount received
     */
    function keeperSwap(
        mapping(address => bool) storage allowedRouters,
        ISmartDCA.Pair storage pair,
        address swapHelper,
        ResilientOracleInterface oracle,
        uint256 stableIn,
        uint256 minOut,
        uint256 maxOracleDeviationBps,
        bytes calldata swapData
    ) external returns (uint256 assetOut) {
        IERC20 stable = IERC20(pair.stable);
        IERC20 asset = IERC20(pair.asset);
        if (maxOracleDeviationBps < SmartDCAMath.BPS) {
            uint256 oracleValue = _oracleValue(oracle, address(stable), address(asset), stableIn);
            uint256 floor = Math.mulDiv(oracleValue, SmartDCAMath.BPS - maxOracleDeviationBps, SmartDCAMath.BPS);
            if (minOut < floor) revert ISmartDCA.QuoteBelowOracle(minOut, floor);
        }
        _checkSwapRoute(allowedRouters, address(stable), address(asset), swapData);
        // Stable held here and in SwapHelper together only falls by what the swap sold, so a refund to SmartDCA,
        // a part left in SwapHelper and dust moved between the two all show as unspent
        uint256 stableHeldBefore = stable.balanceOf(address(this)) + stable.balanceOf(swapHelper);
        uint256 assetBefore = asset.balanceOf(address(this));
        stable.safeTransfer(swapHelper, stableIn);
        (bool success, bytes memory returnData) = swapHelper.call(swapData);
        if (!success) {
            if (returnData.length > 0) {
                assembly {
                    revert(add(returnData, 32), mload(returnData))
                }
            }
            revert ISmartDCA.SwapFailed();
        }
        uint256 stableHeldAfter = stable.balanceOf(address(this)) + stable.balanceOf(swapHelper);
        uint256 stableSpent = stableHeldBefore > stableHeldAfter ? stableHeldBefore - stableHeldAfter : 0;
        if (stableSpent < stableIn) revert ISmartDCA.PartNotFullySwapped(stableIn, stableSpent);
        assetOut = asset.balanceOf(address(this)) - assetBefore;
        if (assetOut < minOut) revert ISmartDCA.SlippageExceeded(assetOut, minOut);
    }

    /**
     * @notice What SmartDCA owes in `token`: source shares of every pair, plus the stable left to swap and the
     *         asset bought in each running round
     * @dev Several pairs can share one source, so their shares add up
     * @param pairs Pairs by id
     * @param rounds Rounds by pair and round number
     * @param yieldSources Yield sources by pair and side
     * @param pairCount Number of pairs
     * @param token Token to count
     * @return owed Amount of `token` that belongs to plans
     */
    function owedInToken(
        mapping(uint32 => ISmartDCA.Pair) storage pairs,
        mapping(uint32 => mapping(uint32 => ISmartDCA.Round)) storage rounds,
        mapping(uint32 => mapping(ISmartDCA.Side => ISmartDCA.YieldSource)) storage yieldSources,
        uint32 pairCount,
        address token
    ) external view returns (uint256 owed) {
        for (uint32 id = 1; id <= pairCount; ++id) {
            ISmartDCA.YieldSource storage stableSource = yieldSources[id][ISmartDCA.Side.Stable];
            ISmartDCA.YieldSource storage assetSource = yieldSources[id][ISmartDCA.Side.Asset];
            if (stableSource.sourceAddress == token) owed += stableSource.sharesHeld;
            if (assetSource.sourceAddress == token) owed += assetSource.sharesHeld;

            ISmartDCA.Pair storage pair = pairs[id];
            ISmartDCA.Round storage r = rounds[id][pair.lastSettledRound + 1];
            if (r.partsTotal == 0) continue;
            if (pair.stable == token) owed += r.stableToSwap;
            if (pair.asset == token) owed += r.assetBought;
        }
    }

    /**
     * @notice Checks and records the source of one side of a pair, and moves that side's holdings to it
     * @param pair The pair
     * @param current The side's yield source record
     * @param pairId Id of the pair
     * @param side Stable or asset side
     * @param kind Kind of the new source
     * @param source Hub or vToken to hold the side's token
     * @param hubRegistry Registry Hub sources must be in
     * @param comptroller Comptroller Core sources must be listed in
     * @param nextRoundStarted Whether the pair's next round has started; the stable side's holdings cannot move then
     */
    function setYieldSource(
        ISmartDCA.Pair storage pair,
        ISmartDCA.YieldSource storage current,
        uint32 pairId,
        ISmartDCA.Side side,
        ISmartDCA.SourceKind kind,
        address source,
        IHubRegistry hubRegistry,
        IComptroller comptroller,
        bool nextRoundStarted
    ) public {
        if (source == address(0)) revert ISmartDCA.ZeroAddress();
        address token = side == ISmartDCA.Side.Stable ? pair.stable : pair.asset;
        if (kind == ISmartDCA.SourceKind.Hub) {
            if (!hubRegistry.isHub(source) || IHub(source).asset() != token) revert ISmartDCA.InvalidSource(source);
        } else if (kind == ISmartDCA.SourceKind.Core) {
            (bool isListed, , ) = comptroller.markets(source);
            if (!isListed || IVToken(source).underlying() != token) revert ISmartDCA.InvalidSource(source);
        } else {
            revert ISmartDCA.InvalidSource(source);
        }
        if (current.sourceAddress == source) revert ISmartDCA.SourceUnchanged();

        // Holdings move in the same call; the number of units does not change, so no plan record changes
        uint256 migrated;
        uint256 oldShares = current.sharesHeld;
        if (oldShares != 0) {
            // A running round holds its bought asset as tokens and settles into the current source, so only the
            // stable side locks. The asset side can then move away from a source that refuses the settle deposit.
            if (nextRoundStarted && side == ISmartDCA.Side.Stable) revert ISmartDCA.PairLocked(pairId);
            current.sharesHeld = 0;
            migrated = sourceRedeem(current, token, oldShares);
        }
        address oldSource = current.sourceAddress;
        current.kind = kind;
        current.sourceAddress = source;
        if (migrated != 0) current.sharesHeld = sourceDeposit(current, token, migrated);
        // Units with no shares behind them would let the next deposit mint units 1:1 and lose most of its value
        if (current.unitsIssued != 0 && current.sharesHeld == 0) revert ISmartDCA.InvalidSource(source);

        emit ISmartDCA.YieldSourceUpdated(pairId, side, oldSource, kind, source, migrated);
    }

    /**
     * @notice Deposits into the source and returns the shares received, measured as a balance change
     * @param s The yield source
     * @param token Token deposited
     * @param amount Amount of `token`
     * @return Shares received
     */
    function sourceDeposit(ISmartDCA.YieldSource storage s, address token, uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256) {
        address source = s.sourceAddress;
        uint256 sharesBefore = IERC20(source).balanceOf(address(this));
        IERC20(token).forceApprove(source, amount);
        if (s.kind == ISmartDCA.SourceKind.Hub) {
            IHub(source).deposit(amount, address(this));
        } else {
            uint256 err = IVToken(source).mint(amount);
            if (err != 0) revert ISmartDCA.SourceCallFailed(source, err);
        }
        return IERC20(source).balanceOf(address(this)) - sharesBefore;
    }

    /**
     * @notice Redeems shares from the source and returns the token amount received, measured as a balance change
     * @param s The yield source
     * @param token Token received
     * @param shares Source shares to redeem
     * @return Amount of `token` received
     */
    function sourceRedeem(ISmartDCA.YieldSource storage s, address token, uint256 shares) internal returns (uint256) {
        address source = s.sourceAddress;
        uint256 balanceBefore = IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this));
        if (s.kind == ISmartDCA.SourceKind.Hub) {
            IHub(source).redeem(shares, address(this), address(this));
        } else {
            uint256 err = IVToken(source).redeem(shares);
            if (err != 0) revert ISmartDCA.SourceCallFailed(source, err);
        }
        return IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this)) - balanceBefore;
    }

    /// @dev Oracle value of `amount` of `stable` in `asset`. Oracle prices are scaled by 10^(36 - decimals), so this
    ///      converts across decimals.
    function _oracleValue(
        ResilientOracleInterface oracle,
        address stable,
        address asset,
        uint256 amount
    ) private view returns (uint256) {
        return Math.mulDiv(amount, oracle.getPrice(stable), oracle.getPrice(asset));
    }

    /**
     * @notice Checks a keeper's swap before it runs: it must be a `SwapHelper.multicall` whose `genericCall` targets
     *         and `approveMax` spenders are all on `allowedRouters`, and whose `sweep` calls all send the pair's
     *         stable or asset to SmartDCA
     * @dev Any other inner call reverts. The library runs through DELEGATECALL, so `address(this)` is SmartDCA.
     *      The sweep token check rejects a route that sweeps another pair's asset, such as a USDT to ETH part whose
     *      route sweeps BTCB. A route whose router pays SmartDCA directly is not checked here; `minOut` bounds it.
     * @param allowedRouters Routers a keeper swap may call or approve
     * @param stable The pair's stable
     * @param asset The pair's asset
     * @param swapData The keeper's `SwapHelper.multicall` calldata
     */
    function _checkSwapRoute(
        mapping(address => bool) storage allowedRouters,
        address stable,
        address asset,
        bytes calldata swapData
    ) private view {
        if (swapData.length < 4 || bytes4(swapData[:4]) != SwapHelper.multicall.selector) {
            revert ISmartDCA.SwapCallNotAllowed();
        }
        (bytes[] memory calls, , , ) = abi.decode(swapData[4:], (bytes[], uint256, bytes32, bytes));
        for (uint256 i; i < calls.length; ++i) {
            bytes memory data = calls[i];
            // All three allowed calls take two arguments: (target, data), (token, spender) and (token, to)
            if (data.length < 68) revert ISmartDCA.SwapCallNotAllowed();
            bytes4 selector = bytes4(data);
            if (selector == SwapHelper.genericCall.selector) {
                address target = _argument(data, 0);
                if (!allowedRouters[target]) revert ISmartDCA.RouterNotAllowed(target);
            } else if (selector == SwapHelper.approveMax.selector) {
                address spender = _argument(data, 1);
                if (!allowedRouters[spender]) revert ISmartDCA.RouterNotAllowed(spender);
            } else if (selector == SwapHelper.sweep.selector) {
                address token = _argument(data, 0);
                if (_argument(data, 1) != address(this) || (token != stable && token != asset)) {
                    revert ISmartDCA.SwapCallNotAllowed();
                }
            } else {
                revert ISmartDCA.SwapCallNotAllowed();
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * @notice Reads argument `index` of an ABI encoded call as an address
     * @dev Takes the low 20 bytes of the word. A word with dirty high bytes fails ABI decoding in SwapHelper, so the
     *      call reverts there anyway.
     * @param data Selector followed by the encoded arguments; at least `4 + 32 * (index + 1)` bytes long
     * @param index Position of the argument
     * @return The argument
     */
    function _argument(bytes memory data, uint256 index) private pure returns (address) {
        uint256 word;
        // Skips the 32 byte length and the 4 byte selector
        assembly ("memory-safe") {
            word := mload(add(data, add(36, mul(index, 32))))
        }
        return address(uint160(word));
    }
}

pragma solidity 0.8.28;

import { Math } from "@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/Math.sol";

/**
 * @title SmartDCAMath
 * @author Venus
 * @notice Pure math for SmartDCA: round dates, the round fee and the index steps that credit plans.
 * @dev A month is counted as `year * 12 + (month - 1)`, so November 2026 is month 24322. Round `r` is month
 *      `anchorMonth + r`, where `anchorMonth` is set once at deploy. It starts (locks) on the 15th of that month at
 *      00:00 UTC+8, which is the 14th at 16:00 UTC. Fees, index steps and bought amounts round down: a fee never
 *      takes more than its rate, and plans are never credited more asset than a round bought.
 */
library SmartDCAMath {
    /// @notice Day of the month a round starts on
    uint256 internal constant ROUND_DAY = 15;

    /// @notice Rounds start at 00:00 UTC+8, this long before 00:00 UTC
    uint256 internal constant UTC8_OFFSET = 8 hours;

    /// @notice Scale of the asset indexes, 1e36 like the Venus reward indexes
    uint256 internal constant INDEX_SCALE = 1e36;

    /// @notice Basis points in 100%
    uint256 internal constant BPS = 10_000;

    /**
     * @notice Start (lock) time of a round: the `ROUND_DAY` of its month at 00:00 UTC+8
     * @param anchorMonth Month of round 0
     * @param round Round number
     * @return Unix timestamp
     */
    function roundStart(uint256 anchorMonth, uint32 round) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        uint256 m = anchorMonth + round;
        return _daysFromCivil(m / 12, (m % 12) + 1, ROUND_DAY) * 1 days - UTC8_OFFSET;
    }

    /**
     * @notice Month of the latest round start at or before `timestamp`
     * @dev Moving `timestamp` back by `ROUND_DAY - 1` days less `UTC8_OFFSET` lands in that month. Sets `anchorMonth`
     *      at deploy, and a new pair's last settled round, so its first round is the next to start.
     * @param timestamp Unix timestamp, at least `(ROUND_DAY - 1) days - UTC8_OFFSET`
     * @return Month, counted as `year * 12 + (month - 1)`
     */
    function latestStartedMonth(uint256 timestamp) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        uint256 shift = (ROUND_DAY - 1) * 1 days - UTC8_OFFSET;
        (uint256 year, uint256 month) = _civilFromDays((timestamp - shift) / 1 days);
        return year * 12 + month - 1;
    }

    /**
     * @notice Fee a round takes on the interest part of what it redeemed
     * @param stableRedeemed Stable amount the round redeemed
     * @param roundPrincipal Principal of the round's plans
     * @param feeRateBps Fee rate, in basis points
     * @return fee Stable amount for the Reserve
     * @return rateCharged `feeRateBps`, or 0 when the round redeemed no more than its principal
     */
    function roundFee(
        uint256 stableRedeemed,
        uint256 roundPrincipal,
        uint16 feeRateBps
    ) internal pure returns (uint256 fee, uint16 rateCharged) {
        if (stableRedeemed <= roundPrincipal) return (0, 0);
        return (((stableRedeemed - roundPrincipal) * feeRateBps) / BPS, feeRateBps);
    }

    /**
     * @notice Index steps that split a round's asset units over its plans
     * @dev With `e = rateBps / BPS`, a plan's share of the round's net stable is
     *      `stableUnitsPerBuy * stableRedeemed / roundStableUnits * (1 - e) + principalPerBuy * e`, so it pays the fee
     *      on its own interest only. Summed over the round's plans that is `stableNet`. Splitting `assetUnits` in the
     *      same ratio gives a plan
     *      `stableUnitsPerBuy * perUnitStep / INDEX_SCALE + principalPerBuy * perPrincipalStep / INDEX_SCALE`.
     * @param assetUnits Asset units minted for what the round bought
     * @param stableRedeemed Stable amount the round redeemed
     * @param stableNet `stableRedeemed` less the fee
     * @param roundStableUnits Stable units the round sold
     * @param rateBps Fee rate the round charged, in basis points
     * @return perUnitStep Asset units per stable unit sold, scaled by `INDEX_SCALE`
     * @return perPrincipalStep Asset units per wei of principal, scaled by `INDEX_SCALE`
     */
    function roundIndexSteps(
        uint256 assetUnits,
        uint256 stableRedeemed,
        uint256 stableNet,
        uint256 roundStableUnits,
        uint16 rateBps
    ) internal pure returns (uint256 perUnitStep, uint256 perPrincipalStep) {
        uint256 scaled = assetUnits * INDEX_SCALE;
        perUnitStep = Math.mulDiv(scaled, stableRedeemed * (BPS - rateBps), roundStableUnits * stableNet * BPS);
        perPrincipalStep = Math.mulDiv(scaled, rateBps, stableNet * BPS);
    }

    /**
     * @notice Buys of a plan's schedule that have settled
     * @param lastSettledRound Pair's last settled round
     * @param firstRound First round of the schedule
     * @param buys Buys in the schedule
     * @return Settled buys, at most `buys`
     */
    function buysSettled(uint32 lastSettledRound, uint32 firstRound, uint8 buys) internal pure returns (uint8) {
        if (lastSettledRound < firstRound) return 0;
        uint256 settled = lastSettledRound - firstRound + 1;
        return settled > buys ? buys : uint8(settled);
    }

    /**
     * @notice Whether a plan is in the pair's next round and that round's lock time has passed
     * @param nextRound Pair's next round, `lastSettledRound + 1`
     * @param firstRound First round of the plan's schedule
     * @param buys Buys in the schedule
     * @param nextRoundStarted Whether the next round's start time has passed
     * @return True while the plan's buy is in a locked round that has not settled
     */
    function inRunningRound(
        uint32 nextRound,
        uint32 firstRound,
        uint8 buys,
        bool nextRoundStarted
    ) internal pure returns (bool) {
        return nextRoundStarted && nextRound >= firstRound && nextRound < firstRound + buys;
    }

    /**
     * @notice Asset units a plan bought between two index readings
     * @param stableUnitsPerBuy Plan's stable units per buy
     * @param principalPerBuy Plan's principal per buy
     * @param perUnitIndexGrowth Growth of `assetPerUnitIndex` over the plan's settled rounds
     * @param perPrincipalIndexGrowth Growth of `assetPerPrincipalIndex` over the same rounds
     * @return Asset units, rounded down
     */
    function assetUnitsBought(
        uint256 stableUnitsPerBuy,
        uint256 principalPerBuy,
        uint256 perUnitIndexGrowth,
        uint256 perPrincipalIndexGrowth
    ) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return
            Math.mulDiv(stableUnitsPerBuy, perUnitIndexGrowth, INDEX_SCALE) +
            Math.mulDiv(principalPerBuy, perPrincipalIndexGrowth, INDEX_SCALE);
    }

    /// @dev Days from 1970-01-01 to a date. Howard Hinnant's algorithm, for years from 1970.
    function _daysFromCivil(uint256 year, uint256 month, uint256 day) private pure returns (uint256) {
        if (month <= 2) year -= 1;
        uint256 era = year / 400;
        uint256 yoe = year - era * 400;
        uint256 doy = (153 * (month > 2 ? month - 3 : month + 9) + 2) / 5 + day - 1;
        uint256 doe = yoe * 365 + yoe / 4 - yoe / 100 + doy;
        return era * 146_097 + doe - 719_468;
    }

    /// @dev Year and month of a day count from 1970-01-01. Inverse of `_daysFromCivil`.
    function _civilFromDays(uint256 z) private pure returns (uint256 year, uint256 month) {
        z += 719_468;
        uint256 era = z / 146_097;
        uint256 doe = z - era * 146_097;
        uint256 yoe = (doe - doe / 1460 + doe / 36_524 - doe / 146_096) / 365;
        uint256 doy = doe - (365 * yoe + yoe / 4 - yoe / 100);
        uint256 mp = (5 * doy + 2) / 153;
        month = mp < 10 ? mp + 3 : mp - 9;
        year = yoe + era * 400 + (month <= 2 ? 1 : 0);
    }
}

pragma solidity 0.8.28;

import {
    SafeERC20Upgradeable,
    IERC20Upgradeable
} from "@openzeppelin/contracts-upgradeable/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20Upgradeable.sol";
import { AddressUpgradeable } from "@openzeppelin/contracts-upgradeable/utils/AddressUpgradeable.sol";
import { EIP712 } from "@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/cryptography/EIP712.sol";
import { ECDSA } from "@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/cryptography/ECDSA.sol";
import { Ownable2Step } from "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable2Step.sol";
import { ReentrancyGuard } from "@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol";

/**
 * @title SwapHelper
 * @author Venus Protocol
 * @notice Helper contract for executing multiple token operations atomically
 * @dev This contract provides utilities for managing approvals,
 *      and executing arbitrary calls in a single transaction. It supports
 *      signature verification using EIP-712 for backend-authorized operations.
 *      All functions except multicall are designed to be called internally via multicall.
 * @custom:security-contact security@venus.io
 */
contract SwapHelper is EIP712, Ownable2Step, ReentrancyGuard {
    using SafeERC20Upgradeable for IERC20Upgradeable;
    using AddressUpgradeable for address;

    /// @notice EIP-712 typehash for Multicall struct used in signature verification
    /// @dev keccak256("Multicall(address caller,bytes[] calls,uint256 deadline,bytes32 salt)")
    bytes32 internal constant MULTICALL_TYPEHASH =
        keccak256("Multicall(address caller,bytes[] calls,uint256 deadline,bytes32 salt)");

    /// @notice Address authorized to sign multicall operations
    /// @dev Can be updated by contract owner via setBackendSigner
    address public backendSigner;

    /// @notice Mapping to track used salts for replay protection
    /// @dev Maps salt => bool to prevent reuse of same salt
    mapping(bytes32 => bool) public usedSalts;

    /// @notice Error thrown when transaction deadline has passed
    /// @dev Emitted when block.timestamp > deadline in multicall
    error DeadlineReached();

    /// @notice Error thrown when signature verification fails
    /// @dev Emitted when recovered signer doesn't match backendSigner
    error Unauthorized();

    /// @notice Error thrown when zero address is provided as parameter
    /// @dev Used in constructor and setBackendSigner validation
    error ZeroAddress();

    /// @notice Error thrown when salt has already been used
    /// @dev Prevents replay attacks by ensuring each salt is used only once
    error SaltAlreadyUsed();

    /// @notice Error thrown when caller is not authorized
    /// @dev Only owner or contract itself can call protected functions
    error CallerNotAuthorized();

    /// @notice Error thrown when no calls are provided to multicall
    /// @dev Emitted when calls array is empty in multicall
    error NoCallsProvided();

    /// @notice Error thrown when signature is missing but required
    /// @dev Emitted when signature length is zero but verification is expected
    error MissingSignature();

    /// @notice Event emitted when backend signer is updated
    /// @param oldSigner Previous backend signer address
    /// @param newSigner New backend signer address
    event BackendSignerUpdated(address indexed oldSigner, address indexed newSigner);

    /// @notice Event emitted when multicall is successfully executed
    /// @param caller Address that initiated the multicall
    /// @param callsCount Number of calls executed in the batch
    /// @param deadline Deadline timestamp used for the operation
    /// @param salt Salt used for replay protection
    event MulticallExecuted(address indexed caller, uint256 callsCount, uint256 deadline, bytes32 salt);

    /// @notice Event emitted when tokens are swept from the contract
    /// @param token Address of the token swept
    /// @param to Recipient address
    /// @param amount Amount of tokens swept
    event Swept(address indexed token, address indexed to, uint256 amount);

    /// @notice Event emitted when maximum approval is granted
    /// @param token Address of the token approved
    /// @param spender Address granted the approval
    event ApprovedMax(address indexed token, address indexed spender);

    /// @notice Event emitted when generic call is executed
    /// @param target Address of the contract called
    /// @param data Encoded function call data
    event GenericCallExecuted(address indexed target, bytes data);

    /// @notice Constructor
    /// @param backendSigner_ Address authorized to sign multicall operations
    /// @dev Initializes EIP-712 domain with name "VenusSwap" and version "1"
    /// @dev Transfers ownership to msg.sender
    /// @dev Reverts with ZeroAddress if parameter is address(0)
    /// @custom:error ZeroAddress if backendSigner_ is address(0)
    constructor(address backendSigner_) EIP712("VenusSwap", "1") {
        if (backendSigner_ == address(0)) {
            revert ZeroAddress();
        }

        backendSigner = backendSigner_;
    }

    /// @notice Modifier to restrict access to owner or contract itself
    /// @dev Reverts with CallerNotAuthorized if caller is neither owner nor this contract
    modifier onlyOwnerOrSelf() {
        if (msg.sender != owner() && msg.sender != address(this)) {
            revert CallerNotAuthorized();
        }
        _;
    }

    /// @notice Multicall function to execute multiple calls in a single transaction.
    /// @param calls Array of encoded function calls to execute on this contract
    /// @param deadline Unix timestamp after which the transaction will revert
    /// @param salt Unique value to ensure this exact multicall can only be executed once
    /// @param signature EIP-712 signature from backend signer
    /// @dev All calls are executed atomically - if any call fails, entire transaction reverts
    /// @dev Calls must be to functions on this contract (address(this))
    /// @dev Protected by nonReentrant modifier to prevent reentrancy attacks
    /// @dev This function should be called as a part of a transaction that sends tokens to this contract and verifies if they received desired tokens after execution.
    /// @dev EOA that calls this function should not send tokens directly nor approve this contract to spend tokens on their behalf.
    /// @custom:event MulticallExecuted emitted upon successful execution
    /// @custom:security Only the contract itself can call sweep, approveMax, and genericCall
    /// @custom:error NoCallsProvided if calls array is empty
    /// @custom:error DeadlineReached if block.timestamp > deadline
    /// @custom:error SaltAlreadyUsed if salt has been used before
    /// @custom:error Unauthorized if signature verification fails
    /// @custom:error MissingSignature if signature is empty
    function multicall(
        bytes[] calldata calls,
        uint256 deadline,
        bytes32 salt,
        bytes calldata signature
    ) external nonReentrant {
        if (calls.length == 0) {
            revert NoCallsProvided();
        }

        if (block.timestamp > deadline) {
            revert DeadlineReached();
        }

        if (signature.length == 0) {
            revert MissingSignature();
        }
        if (usedSalts[salt]) {
            revert SaltAlreadyUsed();
        }
        usedSalts[salt] = true;

        bytes32 digest = _hashMulticall(msg.sender, calls, deadline, salt);
        address signer = ECDSA.recover(digest, signature);
        if (signer != backendSigner) {
            revert Unauthorized();
        }

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < calls.length; i++) {
            (bool success, bytes memory returnData) = address(this).call(calls[i]);
            if (!success) {
                assembly {
                    revert(add(returnData, 0x20), mload(returnData))
                }
            }
        }

        emit MulticallExecuted(msg.sender, calls.length, deadline, salt);
    }

    /// @notice Generic call function to execute a call to an arbitrary address
    /// @param target Address of the contract to call
    /// @param data Encoded function call data
    /// @dev This function can interact with any external contract
    /// @dev Should only be called via multicall for safety, but can be called directly by owner
    /// @custom:security Use with extreme caution - can call any contract with any data
    /// @custom:security Ensure proper validation of target and data in off-chain systems
    /// @custom:error CallerNotAuthorized if caller is not owner or contract itself
    function genericCall(address target, bytes calldata data) external onlyOwnerOrSelf {
        target.functionCall(data);
        emit GenericCallExecuted(target, data);
    }

    /// @notice Sweeps entire balance of an ERC-20 token to a specified address
    /// @param token ERC-20 token contract to sweep
    /// @param to Recipient address for the swept tokens
    /// @dev Transfers the entire balance of token held by this contract
    /// @dev Uses SafeERC20 for safe transfer operations
    /// @dev Should only be called via multicall for safety, but can be called directly by owner
    /// @custom:error CallerNotAuthorized if caller is not owner or contract itself
    /// @custom:error ZeroAddress if token is address(0) or to is address(0)
    function sweep(IERC20Upgradeable token, address to) external onlyOwnerOrSelf {
        if (address(token) == address(0) || to == address(0)) {
            revert ZeroAddress();
        }
        uint256 amount = token.balanceOf(address(this));
        if (amount > 0) {
            token.safeTransfer(to, amount);
        }
        emit Swept(address(token), to, amount);
    }

    /// @notice Approves maximum amount of an ERC-20 token to a specified spender
    /// @param token ERC-20 token contract to approve
    /// @param spender Address to grant approval to
    /// @dev Sets approval to type(uint256).max for unlimited spending
    /// @dev Uses forceApprove to handle tokens that require 0 approval first
    /// @dev Should only be called via multicall for safety, but can be called directly by owner
    /// @custom:security Grants unlimited approval - ensure spender is trusted
    /// @custom:error CallerNotAuthorized if caller is not owner or contract itself
    function approveMax(IERC20Upgradeable token, address spender) external onlyOwnerOrSelf {
        token.forceApprove(spender, type(uint256).max);
        emit ApprovedMax(address(token), spender);
    }

    /// @notice Updates the backend signer address
    /// @param newSigner New backend signer address
    /// @dev Only callable by contract owner
    /// @dev Reverts with ZeroAddress if newSigner is address(0)
    /// @dev Emits BackendSignerUpdated event
    /// @custom:error ZeroAddress if newSigner is address(0)
    /// @custom:error Ownable: caller is not the owner (from OpenZeppelin Ownable)
    function setBackendSigner(address newSigner) external onlyOwner {
        if (newSigner == address(0)) {
            revert ZeroAddress();
        }

        emit BackendSignerUpdated(backendSigner, newSigner);
        backendSigner = newSigner;
    }

    /// @notice Produces an EIP-712 digest of the multicall data
    /// @param caller Address of the authorized caller
    /// @param calls Array of encoded function calls
    /// @param deadline Unix timestamp deadline
    /// @param salt Unique value to ensure replay protection
    /// @return EIP-712 typed data hash for signature verification
    /// @dev Hashes each call individually, then encodes with MULTICALL_TYPEHASH, caller, deadline, and salt
    /// @dev Uses EIP-712 _hashTypedDataV4 for domain-separated hashing
    function _hashMulticall(
        address caller,
        bytes[] calldata calls,
        uint256 deadline,
        bytes32 salt
    ) internal view returns (bytes32) {
        bytes32[] memory callHashes = new bytes32[](calls.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < calls.length; i++) {
            callHashes[i] = keccak256(calls[i]);
        }
        return
            _hashTypedDataV4(
                keccak256(
                    abi.encode(MULTICALL_TYPEHASH, caller, keccak256(abi.encodePacked(callHashes)), deadline, salt)
                )
            );
    }
}
